senses.gloss:
घुण r. 1st and 6th cls. (घोणते घुणति) To roll, to whirl, to turn round,
(इ) घुणि r. 1st cl. (घुणते) To take or accept. भ्वा-आ-सक-सेट् । तु-प-अक ।

घुण m. (-णः)
 1. An insect that is found in timber.
 2. The pangolin or
armadillo.
 E. घुण् to turn round, affix क.

घुण्ट m. (-ण्टः) The ankle.
 E. घुट् to resist, affix क and नुम् inserted; also
with कन् added घुण्टक, or without the augment घुट &c. as above.
घुण्टिक n. (-कं) Cowdung found in thickets. घुण्ट-स्तदाकारोऽस्ति अस्य ठन् ।

घुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A large black bee.
 E. घुण् to roll, Uṇādi affix ड.
